resources.string: No Macs paired yet. Open ATA on your Mac, choose \"Pair New Device…\", then scan the QR code it shows.
You will need to pair again before sending files to this Mac.
Choose \"Send to Mac\" in any app\'s share menu to send files to a paired Mac.
The camera cannot be used to scan the QR code on this phone. You can paste the pairing link shown on the Mac instead.
Paired with \"%1$s\". You can now send files from the share menu.
ATA uses Bluetooth to find your Mac nearby and exchange encrypted connection details. It never uses Bluetooth to determine your location.
ATA uses Bluetooth to find your Mac nearby. This Android version requires the location permission for Bluetooth scanning; ATA does not use your location.
ATA cannot find your Mac without this permission. Allow \"Nearby devices\" for ATA in system settings.
With notifications allowed you can follow progress and cancel from the notification shade after leaving this screen.
ATA needs Bluetooth to find your Mac.

Open ATA on the Mac, choose \"Pair New Device…\", then scan the QR code with this phone. Your shared files stay here; once paired you can pick the Mac to send to.
Cannot find \"%1$s\". Make sure it is nearby, ATA is running on it, and Bluetooth is on.
Scan the QR code with the camera
ATA uses the camera only while you scan the pairing QR code. The image is read on this phone and is never saved or sent anywhere. You can also paste the pairing link shown on the Mac instead.
ATA cannot scan the QR code without camera access. Allow the camera for ATA in system settings, or paste the pairing link shown on the Mac instead.
